description: This PHP class implements an MD5 hashing algorithm capable of processing data streams, providing methods for resetting, adding data, and retrieving the current hash context.

classes.name: MD5
classes.description: A class providing an implementation of the MD5 hashing algorithm for data streams within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MD5 class instance and sets up the static all-one-bits property.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal hash state variables to their initial MD5 values.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the current hash context as a string, representing the internal state of the hash.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds data to the hash context, updating the internal state based on the input data.
